research:
I found 9 items from roughly 3 to 17 October 2026. Most sources are third-party blogs and trackers, not official Meta, Shopify or OpenAI pages, so check anything you post as fact against the official page first.

**New features and tools**

1. **Shopify lets outside AI agents shop your catalog (Oct 13).** Shoppers can link agents like Meta's Muse to their Shop account and search and pay through "Shop MCP". Each payment still needs the shopper to confirm. **Why you care:** AI agents are becoming a way people find products, and an agent can only match what your product data says. Messy titles and descriptions now cost you twice. Reports disagree on whether agents can complete checkout on your own store, so don't claim either way. [mlq.ai](https://mlq.ai/news/shopify-lets-shoppers-connect-more-ai-agents-to-its-catalog-and-shop-pay/) · [Wilson's Media](https://www.wilsonsmedia.com/shopify-opens-its-catalog-up-to-more-ai-agents/)

2. **Shopify shows compare-at prices to AI agents (Oct 11).** Agents can now see when a product is marked down. **Why you care:** your Diwali discounts only count with agents if the compare-at price field is filled. That's a 10-minute fix before the sale. [Releasebot (Shopify release notes)](https://releasebot.io/updates/shopify)

3. **Shopify Canvas: build or edit your store by chatting (Oct 1, just outside the window).** You tell Sidekick what to change and see it live. **Why you care:** small teams can test a new homepage or festive banner without a developer. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/01/shopify-debuts-canvas-a-way-to-build-online-stores-by-chatting-with-ai/)

4. **Meta Ads updates from Advertising Week (Oct 6).** These are live: video made from still product images in Advantage+ creative, and a Customer Lifecycle setting that suggests excluding existing buyers from acquisition campaigns. Still in testing: an agent that builds campaigns and moves budget from a chat prompt, imported brand voice guides, and scheduled performance reports. **Why you care:** with ad costs high in festive season, excluding past buyers stops you paying to reach people you already have. The image-to-video tool gives you video ads without a shoot. The "60% faster launch" figure going around has no independent confirmation, so don't repeat it. Checkout inside Messenger chat is US, Canada and Mexico only. [PYMNTS](https://www.pymnts.com/news/artificial-intelligence/2026/meta-debuts-ai-tools-help-advertisers-find-customers/) · [Common Thread](https://commonthreadco.com/blogs/coachs-corner/metas-new-ai-agent-can-now-run-your-ads-what-the-advertising-week-2026-update-means-for-ecommerce-brands)

5. **Instagram changes for businesses (around Oct 12–13).** One tracker says clickable links in feed posts and Reels launched for accounts on a paid "Meta One" business plan. Also reported: tagged posts on your grid, carousels made in the Edits app (iOS first), and Live Video ads on Instagram. **Why you care:** a link inside the Reel would be the shortest path from post to product page, and tagged customer posts are free social proof on your profile. I only found the paid-plan detail in one place, so confirm it before posting. [SocialBee](https://socialbee.com/blog/instagram-updates/) · [Gain Blog](https://blog.gainapp.com/social-media-updates/)

6. **WhatsApp Business API pricing change (from Oct 1).** Service messages are now charged after 1,000 free per number per month. Some sources say order-update templates sent while a support chat is open are now billed too. The normal WhatsApp Business app is not affected. **Why you care:** if you send COD confirmations or cart reminders through a provider like Wati, your bill may go up this festive season. Check Meta's own pricing page, because the sources disagree on the details. [Techweez](https://techweez.com/2026/09/28/whatsapp-business-pricing-october-2026/) · [Asianet Newsable](https://newsable.asianetnews.com/technology/whatsapp-business-new-rules-from-october-1-2026-pricing-free-messages-and-charges-explained-articleshow-12xq5ku)

7. **ChatGPT shopping adds virtual try-on and a Favorites list (Oct 1, just outside the window).** **Why you care:** for fashion and accessory brands, shoppers may try your product on inside ChatGPT before they ever visit your site. Clean product images and data matter more. This comes from one blog, not OpenAI's own notes. [MemoryPlugin blog](https://blog.memoryplugin.com/chatgpt-new-features-october-2026/)

**Festival and sale dates**

8. **Diwali 2026 is 6 to 10 November.** Dhanteras is Fri 6 Nov, Lakshmi Puja Sun 8 Nov, Bhai Dooj Tue 10 Nov. That's about 3 weeks away. Flipkart Big Billion Days started 8–9 Oct, and Amazon's Great Indian Festival was reported to start 8 Oct, so marketplace sales are already running. **Why you care:** the last useful window for prepaid offers, gifting bundles and delivery cut-off messages is now. Some calendars give other dates (one says 20 Oct), but most sources agree on 6 to 10 Nov. [Kissht](https://www.kissht.com/blog/diwali-2026-date-and-lakshmi-puja-timing) · [Indian Retailer](https://indianretailer.com/article/retail-business/retail-trends/festive-sale-2026-flipkart-amazon-myntra-meesho-and-ajio-sale) · [FoneArena](https://www.fonearena.com/blog/?p=492788)

**Problems people are discussing**

9. **Festive COD returns and high ad costs.** In Unicommerce's report, 58% of COD orders came back in the festive quarter last year, against under 15% of prepaid. Brands that brought returns down did three things together: a prepaid discount at checkout, picking couriers by pin code, and checking addresses before dispatch. On ads, 2025 data shows Meta impressions cost 50% more from Navratri to Diwali than in August, and 80% more in Diwali week. **Why you care:** together these hit festive margins hardest. Most 2026 numbers are vendor forecasts, so call them estimates. [Unicommerce](https://unicommerce.com/india-d2c-report-2026-april/) · [Amazon Shipping India](https://shipping.amazon.in/blog/cod-vs-prepaid-festive-season-surge-india) · [ProfitBox360](https://www.profitbox360.com/research/india/ecommerce/festive-sale-ad-costs-dates-india)

**I left out:** Gemini 4 Argon, Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6, because they're model news with nothing new to use. I also found no recent Indian news or merchant complaints about festive problems, only vendor and agency blogs.

**Ideas for the topic bank:** items 8 and 9 fit the planned RTO and SALE posts this week. Items 1, 2 and 7 could be a STORE-style post on whether AI shopping agents can read your product page, which builds on the STORE reel that got the most comments.
